top_choice_rationale: P001 most compellingly recognizes the bounded achievement of correcting SMN2 splicing with antisense intervention to produce decisive clinical benefit in spinal muscular atrophy: a precise mechanism-to-treatment connection mature enough for recognition, while avoiding any unwarranted generalization to antisense medicine as a whole.
recusal_note: No documented connection requiring recusal is apparent from the supplied profile; RNA-processing expertise is not itself a conflict.
